commands.short_outcome: Code review, test gate and alternative fixes
capabilities: Queues the full MAUI Copilot PR review pipeline.
Orchestrates regression cross-references, gate verification, candidate review and fix exploration.
Publishes code review and available platform test evidence in an AI Summary.
limits: Requires current write, maintain or admin permission.
The deprecated /review rerun queue was removed; the normal review command remains.

capabilities: Compares current failures with the latest five completed target-branch runs for each pipeline.
Reports likely PR-caused, likely unrelated, needs human investigation or insufficient data.
limits: Report-only: it does not write tests, rerun CI, change code or approve the PR.
Requires current write, maintain or admin permission.

capabilities: Pins merge-base, PR head and harness before measuring selected managed benchmarks.
Runs isolated managed Release benchmarks in ABBA order on a hosted Linux runner.
Publishes a validated performance report with measured timing, allocations, coverage and follow-up.
limits: Managed measurements are not native device coverage.
Shared-host timings are advisory; a passing subset is not a whole-PR clean verdict.
Requires current write, maintain or admin permission.
commands.recent_improvement: Expandable results and follow-up reports restored in merged PR 39037.

capabilities: Uses reported version boundaries and affected source history to identify introducing-change candidates.
Separates confirmed, likely, candidate and insufficient-evidence verdicts.
Posts one expandable evidence-backed Regression Trace on the triggering issue.
limits: Report-only: it does not reproduce the bug, execute samples, run bisects or push a fix.
Confirmation requires linked same-environment runtime evidence.
Requires current write, maintain or admin permission.

limits: Open PR 39065: not yet a live default-branch slash command.
